home.manifest_part1: Due to the fact that currently there is no service in Poland providing chess games - since the only existing one has been suspended - and as this is an idea worth continuing, but neither PZSzach nor any WZSzach is interested in such a project, this website was created.

gdpr.gdpr_info: Dear GDPR enthusiasts, your games will not be removed, because at the moment a game record is published - just like recordings in any other sport - it enters the public domain (along with names and results). Consequently, everyone has full rights to it.

player.warning: WARNING: More than one player with this surname was found.
games.param.player: You must enter at least one player's last name
games.param.database.pl: Poland - tournaments mainly from Poland, ~700k games, faster database
games.param.database.all: All - all games, ~15M games, slower database
games.param.search.normal: Classic - works with both "Nowak, Jan" and "Nowak, J". Wildcards allowed ( "_" = one character, "%" = any sequence of characters )
games.param.search.exact: Exact - only matches exact input like "Nowak, Jan". Faster, recommended if you know the full name
math.alpha.b: A constant representing after how many years the probability of a move equalizes.
math.alpha.c: A constant representing the current year.
math.alpha.t: The sum of the maximum possible values.
math.alpha.si: Year statistics for a given move.
math.alpha.abs_si: Number of years (occurrences of the move)
math.alpha.vi: Array of values calculated for each statistic
math.alpha.lambda: Scaling factor adjusted based on the maximum value.
math.alpha.l: Function determining the weight of the year
math.alpha.f: Function calculating the scaled trend value for a move
math.beta.xi: Number of games with a given move in a year
math.beta.yi: Number of points in games with a given move in a year
math.beta.ni: Number of games in a year
